label: Telemetry ETL
info: Subscribes to +/+/+/telemetry, validates each payload, checks the asset against the registry, splits signals, rejects a signal with no asset_limits row, and folds the accepted signals into the wide sensor_readings row. Plant and area still come from the topic; they must match the assets row. A refused message is published to the topic rejected and inserted into rejected_messages.

name: Validate and enrich
Look up asset
query: SELECT plant, area FROM assets WHERE asset_id = $1

name: Match registry
Build rejection
Insert rejection
query:
INSERT INTO rejected_messages (rejected_at, topic, errors, payload)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb)

name: Insert reading
Map to SQL params
Look up limits
query: SELECT signal FROM asset_limits WHERE asset_id = $1
